description: Jira Project Management Dashboard — comprehensive view of tasks, sprints, workload, quality, and delivery metrics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total Tasks"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo();

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Open Tasks"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE status NOT IN ('Done', 'Closed', 'Resolved')
  AND project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo();

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Completed"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE status IN ('Done', 'Closed', 'Resolved')
  AND project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo();

WITH started AS (
  SELECT issue_key, MIN(changed_at) AS started_at
  FROM jira_status_history
  WHERE to_status = 'In Progress'
  GROUP BY issue_key
),
completed AS (
  SELECT issue_key, MIN(changed_at) AS done_at
  FROM jira_status_history
  WHERE to_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  GROUP BY issue_key
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.done_at - s.started_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Cycle Time"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced t
JOIN started s ON t.key = s.issue_key
JOIN completed c ON t.key = c.issue_key
WHERE c.done_at > s.started_at
  AND t.project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR t.last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR t.assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR t.task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR t.components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR t.fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND c.done_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND c.done_at <= $__timeTo();

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Overdue"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE due_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  AND status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  AND project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo();

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(story_points), 0) AS "Story Points"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo();

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT task_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY task_type
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT priority,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Open",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Completed"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND priority IS NOT NULL
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY
  CASE priority
    WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1
    WHEN 'High' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Low' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Lowest' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END;

SELECT
  s AS "Sprint",
  COALESCE(SUM(story_points), 0) AS "Committed SP",
  COALESCE(SUM(story_points) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')), 0) AS "Completed SP"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced, UNNEST(all_sprints) AS s
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND array_length(all_sprints, 1) > 0
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY s
ORDER BY s;

SELECT
  s AS "Sprint",
  COUNT(*) AS "Committed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Completed"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced, UNNEST(all_sprints) AS s
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND array_length(all_sprints, 1) > 0
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY s
ORDER BY s;

SELECT
  assignee AS "Assignee",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Total Open",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In Progress') AS "In Progress",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Done",
  COALESCE(SUM(story_points) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')), 0) AS "Story Points",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Overdue",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND assignee IS NOT NULL
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY "Total Open" DESC;

SELECT
  assignee AS "Assignee",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'To Do') AS "To Do",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In Progress') AS "In Progress",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In Review') AS "In Review",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In QA') AS "In QA",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Done"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND assignee IS NOT NULL
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY assignee;

WITH started AS (
  SELECT issue_key, MIN(changed_at) AS started_at
  FROM jira_status_history
  WHERE to_status = 'In Progress'
  GROUP BY issue_key
),
completed AS (
  SELECT issue_key, MIN(changed_at) AS done_at
  FROM jira_status_history
  WHERE to_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  GROUP BY issue_key
)
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', c.done_at) AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.done_at - s.started_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Cycle Time",
  ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.done_at - s.started_at)) / 86400))::numeric, 1) AS "Median Cycle Time"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced t
JOIN started s ON t.key = s.issue_key
JOIN completed c ON t.key = c.issue_key
WHERE c.done_at > s.started_at
  AND t.project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR t.last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR t.assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR t.task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR t.components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR t.fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND c.done_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND c.done_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Created"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', h.changed_at) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT h.issue_key) AS "Resolved"
FROM jira_status_history h
JOIN jira_tasks_enhanced t ON h.issue_key = t.key
WHERE h.to_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  AND t.project IN ($project)
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR t.assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR t.task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR t.components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR t.fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND h.changed_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND h.changed_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

WITH weekly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS time,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('To Do','Backlog','Open')) AS "To Do",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'In Progress') AS "In Progress",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('In Review','In QA','Code Review')) AS "In Review/QA",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Done"
  FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
  WHERE project IN ($project)
    AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
    AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
    AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
    AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
    AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
    AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()
    AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  time,
  SUM("To Do") OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "To Do",
  SUM("In Progress") OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "In Progress",
  SUM("In Review/QA") OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "In Review/QA",
  SUM("Done") OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "Done"
FROM weekly_counts
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Lead Time by Task Type (Avg Days)

targets.rawSql:
WITH completed AS (
  SELECT issue_key, MIN(changed_at) AS done_at
  FROM jira_status_history
  WHERE to_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  GROUP BY issue_key
)
SELECT
  t.task_type AS "Task Type",
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (c.done_at - t.created_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Lead Time",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced t
JOIN completed c ON t.key = c.issue_key
WHERE t.project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR t.last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR t.assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR t.task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR t.components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR t.fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND c.done_at >= $__timeFrom() AND c.done_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY t.task_type
ORDER BY "Avg Lead Time" DESC;

SELECT
  c AS "Component",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Completed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Open"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced, UNNEST(components) AS c
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND array_length(components, 1) > 0
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY c
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  v AS "Release",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
    THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved'))::float / COUNT(*)
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Progress"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced, UNNEST(fix_versions) AS v
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND array_length(fix_versions, 1) > 0
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY v
ORDER BY "Progress" ASC;

SELECT
  COALESCE(root_cause, 'Not Specified') AS "Root Cause",
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND task_type = 'Bug'
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Bugs Created"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project) AND task_type = 'Bug'
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', h.changed_at) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT h.issue_key) AS "Bugs Resolved"
FROM jira_status_history h
JOIN jira_tasks_enhanced t ON h.issue_key = t.key
WHERE h.to_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved') AND t.task_type = 'Bug'
  AND t.project IN ($project)
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR t.assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR t.components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR t.fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND h.changed_at >= $__timeFrom() AND h.changed_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', changed_at) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT issue_key) AS "Reopened"
FROM jira_status_history
WHERE to_status IN ('Reopened','To Do','In Progress')
  AND from_status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  AND project IN ($project)
  AND changed_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND changed_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  assignee AS "Assignee",
  COUNT(*) AS "Overdue"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE due_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  AND status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
  AND assignee IS NOT NULL
  AND project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY "Overdue" DESC;

SELECT age_bucket, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 7 THEN '< 1 week'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 14 THEN '1-2 weeks'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 30 THEN '2-4 weeks'
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 90 THEN '1-3 months'
      ELSE '> 3 months'
    END AS age_bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 7 THEN 1
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 14 THEN 2
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 30 THEN 3
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400 < 90 THEN 4
      ELSE 5
    END AS sort_order
  FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
  WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')
    AND project IN ($project)
    AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
    AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
    AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
    AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
    AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
    AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
) sub
GROUP BY age_bucket, sort_order
ORDER BY sort_order;

SELECT
  key AS "Key",
  summary AS "Summary",
  task_type AS "Type",
  status AS "Status",
  priority AS "Priority",
  assignee AS "Assignee",
  last_sprint AS "Sprint",
  COALESCE(story_points, 0) AS "Story Points",
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - created_at)) / 86400) AS "Days Open",
  TO_CHAR(due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Due Date",
  TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Updated",
  ARRAY_TO_STRING(components, ', ') AS "Components",
  ARRAY_TO_STRING(fix_versions, ', ') AS "Releases",
  epic_name AS "Epic"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT
  last_sprint AS "Sprint",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
    THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved'))::float / COUNT(*)
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Completion Rate"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND last_sprint IS NOT NULL AND last_sprint != ''
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY last_sprint
ORDER BY last_sprint DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  last_sprint AS "Sprint",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Completed",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')) AS "Open",
  COALESCE(SUM(story_points), 0) AS "Total SP",
  COALESCE(SUM(story_points) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved')), 0) AS "Done SP",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0
    THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Done','Closed','Resolved'))::numeric / COUNT(*) * 100
    ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Completion %"
FROM jira_tasks_enhanced
WHERE project IN ($project)
  AND last_sprint IS NOT NULL AND last_sprint != ''
  AND ($sprint = 'All' OR last_sprint IN ($sprint))
  AND ($assignee = 'All' OR assignee IN ($assignee))
  AND ($task_type = 'All' OR task_type IN ($task_type))
  AND ($component = 'All' OR components && ARRAY[$component]::varchar[])
  AND ($release = 'All' OR fix_versions && ARRAY[$release]::varchar[])
  AND created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND created_at <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY last_sprint
ORDER BY last_sprint DESC;
